assertions.name: alpha_is_degree_4_in_h
assertions.unit: |α₆|+|α₈| (must be 0: algebraic side is degree-4 in h)
assertions.source: alg multiplicative integral over 6 Q₈ crossings; order-6 full product is traceless ⇒ α₆=0

description: Empirical h⁶ test for conj:tau-all-orders-bridge. Computes the algebraic (Q₈ crossed-module) coefficients α_{2k} and the Markov-trace (Borromean Jones) coefficients κ_{2k} for k=1..4. FINDING (negative/methodological): (i) α truncates at order 6 (only 6 crossings; α₈=0) while κ is infinite — a structural asymmetry; (ii) at fixed q₀ both are constant sequences so a diagonal lower-triangular fit T_{kk}=κ/α trivially exists, making the dichotomy's hypothesis (1) trivially true at the NUMBER level. The naive empirical fit is NON-DISCRIMINATING; the genuine open content needs a categorical naturality / q-degree constraint on T. Refines (does not resolve) conj:tau-all-orders-bridge.
